architecture: Small unidirectional GRU on 8 ns tokens with native-grid convolution head
loss: Unchanged soft BCE + 2 log-charge Huber + .5 time-offset Huber; no target-delay relaxation
inference: Sliding 1024-point windows, each guarded 500-point core emitted once
input_features: Same five frozen voltage-derived features as prior CNN

calibration.threshold_note: 500 full-avalanche-equivalent charges; amplitude is realized charge, not deposited energy
calibration.true_time: First photon inside the active 6x6 mm plane; source-emission/flight delay is not reconstructed
calibration.dynamic_range_assumption: Adequate range; no ADC clipping, rejection or quantization in this comparison
calibration.retained_response: Actual shared-cell SiPM history, linear electronics, sample aperture and electronic noise
calibration.historical_template_note: Calibration metadata retains original ADC settings; they do not limit input voltage

model_selection: Validation-only macro complete-recovery F1 over thresholds .15 to .85
comparison_limit: Same training ROOTs, features, objective, steps and batch size; different seed and architecture; not an equal wall-time benchmark
